messages:
marta: Heads-up: were launching Private Deployments v1.1 next week with two compliance-focused features: ephemeral auditor environments and automated evidence bundles. Please review the rollout notes and ack.

devon: Link? Is this the same as the earlier VPC GA?

marta: Not identical. This is a point release for Private that adds: (1) ephemeral auditor staging — short-lived clusters auditors can hit, (2) evidence-bundle generator that collects logs, KMS attestations, and configs into a downloadable zip. Rollout notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/private-1.1.

ryan-sre: Ephemeral envs sound great. What's the default TTL and resource footprint?

marta: Default TTL 24h, can be 72h with approval. Pilot quota: 1 ephemeral env per customer during pilot, backed by 1x A10 or 2x T4. See infra section in the release notes.

katie-sales: We'll need customer messaging and a pricing addendum for audits. Any recommended language?

marta: Use the short blurb in release notes under "customer comms". We recommend positioning as: "audit-ready staging and bundled evidence to accelerate compliance reviews". Legal will review specifics.

legal-bot: Legal note: evidence bundle must include key rotation policy and retention window. Customers requesting auditor access must sign a short access attestation. Contact @legal for templates.

devon: Tech question: does the evidence generator include raw traces or redacted summaries?

marta: Configurable. Default bundle redacts PII and excludes raw payloads; full traces can be included only with explicit customer consent and legal sign-off.

ryan-sre: I'll schedule infra tasks to add TTL enforcement and token rotation hooks. ETA Tue EOD.

katie-sales: I'll draft the AE email and pricing guidance. Would like a short one-pager for the field.

marta: Action items: ryan-sre (infra changes, TTL, tokens), devex (one-pager and customer email, cc @katie-sales), legal (finalize attestation). Please ACK here when assigned.

ryan-sre: ACK.

devon: ACK, will test evidence bundle locally and report issues by Mon.

katie-sales: ACK, drafting now.

marta: Thanks all. We'll do a dry-run with 2 pilot customers Wed. Post any blockers here. :rocket:
